intro.sub: Seven months of work behind it. People tapped 8 times, 32 seconds in all. Scroll back.

Nice. Put Clay on her account page too.

stages.answer: On warm, medium skin it reads as a deep red with some brick in it, not brown. Our three testers with your tone all said red. Dab it on for softer.

Filling's booked for Wednesday.
Moved it to Friday, 10 am. The filler confirmed. Nothing else shifts.

Their samples were the cleanest too.
PO-0142 drafted for ₹1,90,000. Waiting on Aditi.
